text:
Alex: quick post — ran back-to-back bench across L4/T4/A10G for embeddings (sparse) and small-chat (seq=128). paste summary + questions.

Maya: nice. can you share p50/p95 and cost per 1M tokens?

Alex: p50/p95 below (ms per request). emb: L4 18/28, T4 35/60, A10G 12/22. chat (seq128): L4 120/230, T4 240/470, A10G 90/160.

Sam: those look right, and A10G wins latency but cost per GPU-hour higher. what about throughput (qps) and GPU utilization?

Alex: throughput and utilization:
```
workload, gpu, qps, gpu_util
embeddings, l4, 900, 42%
embeddings, t4, 420, 38%
embeddings, a10g, 2200, 65%
chat128, l4, 140, 55%
chat128, t4, 68, 48%
chat128, a10g, 330, 72%
```

Maya: interesting — L4 is sweetspot for mid-cost predictable throughput for chat; A10G gives headroom for emb at high concurrency.

Paul: note region delta — eu-west vs us-west change kernel perf. eu has ~8-12% higher latency on T4 due to driver mismatch we saw.

Li: quantization results? 4bit/8bit?

Alex: tried GPTQ 4-bit for emb only (no quality regressions detected on small eval set). for chat we saw hallucination increase ~1.2% on rouge for 4-bit; 8-bit is near identical.

Sam: kernel choice — we used Triton kernels for A10G, CUDA native for T4. CV notes: use fused attention for seq<=256, native matmul sharded for >256.

infra-bot: Benchmark run complete: https://redwood.internal/bench/1801234567 (artifact attached)

Maya: cost calc I ran per 1M tokens using spot pricing:
```
A10G: $3.1
L4: $1.9
T4: $0.95
```
These assume 70% util for A10G, 50% for L4, 40% for T4 and batching improvements.

Paul: region multiplier: ap-southeast ~+20% infra cost, eu ~+8%.

Eva: recommendation: for embeddings-heavy product -> A10G reserved pools + aggressive batching; for chat low-latency -> L4 Dedicated with 8-bit quant and prefix cache.

Alex: next steps — run extended eval on larger eval set (10k prompts) for 4-bit emb and 8-bit chat, and rerun kernel autotune across eu/us. tagging people: @Maya @Sam @Li ; will spin tests tomorrow.

Maya: ack :thumbsup:

Sam: will add kernel autotune job to pipeline.

Li: will start the 10k eval.

Eva: I'll update docs with recommended configs.
